items.title: Roughly how much does each specific anchor term narrow the results?
items.description: This is an illustrative, order-of-magnitude model, not a precise prediction for any real search engine — but it captures the shape of what happened to Jordan's search. Each genuinely specific anchor term (a model number, an exact symptom, a version) tends to rule out roughly nine out of every ten remaining results, since most sources won't happen to match a term that specific. Drag the slider to see how quickly that compounds, starting from the 40,000+ results the vague query actually returned.
items.compute: const baselineResults = 42000; const resultsRemaining = Math.round(baselineResults / Math.pow(10, params.numAnchors)); return { resultsRemaining };
